dialogues.title: Nice to meet you
dialogues.scene: 两个新同学第一次见面

lines.en: Hi! I'm Lily. What's your name?
lines.zh: 嗨！我叫莉莉。你叫什么名字？

lines.en: Hello, Lily. My name is Tom.
Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?
lines.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。你是哪里人？

lines.en: Good morning. What would you like?
Can I have a chocolate cake?
lines.zh: 能给我一块巧克力蛋糕吗？

lines.en: Thank you. Have a nice day!

dialogues.title: My family
dialogues.scene: 两个朋友看照片聊家人

lines.en: Yes. This is my mother, and this is my father.
lines.zh: 是的。这是我妈妈，这是我爸爸。

lines.en: He's my brother, Leo. He is ten.
lines.zh: 他是我弟弟利奥。他十岁。

lines.en: No, I don't. Do you have brothers or sisters?
I have one sister. She is a teacher.
lines.zh: 我有一个姐姐。她是老师。

lines.en: Cool! And you have a dog, right?
lines.zh: 真酷！你还有一只狗，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, his name is Max. He is very big!
lines.zh: 对，它叫马克斯。它特别大！

lines.en: Excuse me, what time is it?
Thank you. When is the next bus?
lines.zh: 谢谢。下一班公交车是几点？

lines.en: Oh no, I'm late for work!
Don't worry. The bus is always fast.
lines.zh: 别担心。这班车总是开得很快。

sentences.en: My name is Emma.
sentences.zh: 我叫艾玛。

sentences.en: I get up at seven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我七点起床。

sentences.en: I have bread and milk for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我早餐吃面包、喝牛奶。

sentences.en: I go to school by bike.
sentences.zh: 我骑自行车去上学。

sentences.en: School starts at eight thirty.
sentences.zh: 学校八点半开始上课。

sentences.en: In the evening, I do my homework and watch TV.
sentences.zh: 晚上，我写作业、看电视。

sentences.en: I go to bed at ten.
sentences.zh: 我十点睡觉。

questions.q: What time does Emma get up?
How does she go to school?
What does she have for breakfast?

sentences.en: This is my room.
sentences.zh: 这是我的房间。

sentences.en: It is small, but I like it.
sentences.zh: 它很小，但我喜欢它。

sentences.en: There is a bed next to the window.
sentences.zh: 窗户旁边有一张床。

sentences.en: My desk is in front of the bed.
sentences.zh: 我的书桌在床的前面。

sentences.en: There are three books and a lamp on the desk.
sentences.zh: 书桌上有三本书和一盏台灯。

sentences.en: My cat often sleeps under the desk.
sentences.zh: 我的猫经常在书桌下睡觉。

questions.q: How many books are on the desk?

sentences.en: Good morning! Here is the weather for today.
sentences.zh: 早上好！下面是今天的天气。

sentences.en: In the morning, it is sunny and warm.
sentences.zh: 上午晴朗温暖。

sentences.en: In the afternoon, it is cloudy.
sentences.zh: 下午多云。

sentences.en: In the evening, it will rain.
sentences.zh: 晚上会下雨。

sentences.en: Take an umbrella with you!
sentences.zh: 记得带伞！

sentences.en: It is twenty degrees today.
sentences.zh: 今天二十度。

questions.q: What is the weather like in the morning?

sentences.en: Today I go to the supermarket with my mum.
sentences.zh: 今天我和妈妈去超市。

sentences.en: We buy apples, bananas and eggs.
sentences.zh: 我们买了苹果、香蕉和鸡蛋。

sentences.en: My mum also buys some fish for dinner.
sentences.zh: 妈妈还买了一些鱼做晚饭。

sentences.en: I want ice cream, but she says no.
sentences.zh: 我想要冰淇淋，但她说不行。

sentences.en: Everything costs twenty-five dollars.
sentences.zh: 所有东西一共二十五美元。

questions.q: Who goes to the supermarket with the boy?
What do they buy for dinner?

news.title: Birds are more afraid of women

sentences.en: Scientists watched birds in city parks.
sentences.zh: 科学家观察了城市公园里的鸟。

sentences.en: They worked in five countries in Europe.
sentences.zh: 他们在欧洲的五个国家开展研究。

sentences.en: A man or a woman walked slowly to a bird.
sentences.zh: 一名男性或女性慢慢走向一只鸟。

sentences.en: The men and women wore the same clothes.
sentences.zh: 这些男性和女性穿着同样的衣服。

sentences.en: The birds flew away faster from women.
sentences.zh: 鸟在女性靠近时飞走得更快。

sentences.en: Men could get about one metre closer.
sentences.zh: 男性能再靠近大约一米。

sentences.en: Why? The scientists do not know.
sentences.zh: 为什么？科学家也不知道。

sentences.en: Perseverance is a robot car on Mars.
sentences.zh: “毅力号”是火星上的一辆机器人车。

sentences.en: It is from NASA in the United States.
sentences.zh: 它来自美国国家航空航天局（NASA）。

sentences.en: It went to Mars in 2021.
sentences.zh: 它在2021年到达火星。

sentences.en: Now it has driven more than 45 kilometres.
sentences.zh: 现在它已经行驶了超过45公里。

sentences.en: This is a new record.
sentences.zh: 这是一项新纪录。

sentences.en: No car has driven so far on another world.
sentences.zh: 没有任何车在另一个星球上开过这么远。

sentences.en: The rover looks for very old rocks.
sentences.zh: 这辆火星车在寻找非常古老的岩石。

news.title: A small robot can swim
news.titleZh: 一个会游泳的小机器人

sentences.en: Scientists at MIT made a very small robot.
sentences.zh: 麻省理工学院的科学家做了一个非常小的机器人。

sentences.en: It is thin, like paper.
sentences.zh: 它很薄，像纸一样。

sentences.en: It has two fins, like a fish.
sentences.zh: 它有两个鳍，像鱼一样。

sentences.en: The fins have real muscle cells.
sentences.zh: 鳍上有真正的肌肉细胞。

sentences.en: When light shines on a fin, the fin moves.
sentences.zh: 当光照在一个鳍上时，这个鳍就会动。

sentences.en: The robot can swim and turn in water.
sentences.zh: 这个机器人能在水里游泳和转弯。

sentences.en: It can even swim through a small maze.
sentences.zh: 它甚至能游过一个小迷宫。
